title: Discovery endpoints — agent.json and products
context: ACP spec requires a well-known discovery doc and a catalog feed, both unauthenticated per spec (see chipp.ai/docs/acp/authentication auth table: GET /.well-known/agent.json and GET /products require no auth).
objective: Implement the two public discovery/catalog endpoints.
scope_in: GET /.well-known/agent.json returning: supported spec version 2026-04-17, list of supported endpoints, auth method description, payment_provider = razorpay
GET /products returning an array of product objects: id, name, price, currency, description
scope_out: No auth on either endpoint — do not add any
acceptance_criteria: curl GET /.well-known/agent.json returns valid JSON with no auth header sent
curl GET /products returns valid JSON with no auth header sent
Response shapes match a hand-written example in the task notes before merging
